notes.title: More news about Early Access and new Demo version🚘📢
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you for your patience. I owe you an update.

During development, some plans have shifted, which caused delays. Unfortunately, this also means the release has been postponed once more.


So, the million-dollar question: When is the Early Access release? Is it even coming? 


The Early Access version is planned & set for after Next Fest, in November. There will be no more delays.

Yeah, it’s a bit late, but it’s coming… 

and lastly about this subject, I want to clear out want thing: I really, REALLY want to share the game with you, but I don’t want to rush and panic-release it before it’s polished and ready. 


[hr][/hr]


The good news is: on September 16th, I’ll be releasing an updated demo! 

The demo will include:

Updated looks of Water Hose 1 and Water Hose 2

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/8c75f77b1e2d8b9d1245a04136c70c1d7e766d15.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/af2570ea0b371fac08f7b56aa02b11f8d1646061.png"]





A new Washing tool[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/8694a0c6228135e08b3d8296208602380af2f106.png"]

The X-RAY feature

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/2ac6540b7c92a444a34db146ba5a92962420afe7.gif"]

A new hand model & animations



If you already played the prologue version, you can skip this one and wait for Early Access as it's coming soon. This version is mostly aimed for new players. 

But if you’d like to try out these new features, give it a go! 

(Prologue saves won't be compatible)


[hr][/hr]


I’ll also start sharing more in-development updates on both Discord and Steam, so keep an eye out.



Thank you once again for your support and understanding.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask. 
I’d really love to hear from you! 



Apologies for the unfortunate delay.

 

Love 

-Yekta
